concept.title: The DITA content system
concept.shortdesc: DITA architecture works as an interconnected system where maps and topics can be reused in

conbody.p:
DITA architecture works as an interconnected system where maps and topics can be reused in a hierarchical structure:
Topics: Topics are the fundamental building blocks containing content.
Maps: Book maps and DITA maps act as containers that assemble topics into structured documentation, without altering the topics themselves. They define what content appears where and in what order, while the source topics remain independent and reusable.
Reuse mechanism: The reuse mechanism allow content within topics to be referenced and reused across multiple maps and contexts.
This relationship ensures that a single topic can appear in multiple outputs, while shared content within topics can be centrally managed and dynamically inserted wherever needed.
